items.title: Cognition helps Devin test its own work with GPT‑6 Astra
items.content: GPT‑6 Astra improves Devin’s ability to test software and show that it works, with the goal of helping engineers review less code and ship more.
items.contentSnippet: GPT‑6 Astra improves Devin’s ability to test software and show that it works, with the goal of helping engineers review less code and ship more.
items.summary: Cognition宣布其AI软件工程师Devin借助GPT-6 Astra模型提升自我测试能力，旨在帮助工程师减少代码审查工作量并加快软件发布。该进展体现了AI Agent在代码质量保障领域的探索，但目前披露信息有限，具体技术细节待进一步公开。
items.ai_reason: AI Agent Devin结合GPT-6进行自测的进展，属于核心关注领域（AI Agent+测试智能化），但仅为产品新闻公告，缺乏技术实现细节
